card.name: Past-time words in news-style text
card.fires_on: Words that place an event in the past, such as 'last week', 'a few weeks ago', 'this past February' or 'yesterday', in news or article text. It fires on the time word itself, when the sentence is about something already done.

modes.label: Past time phrases
modes.description: The time word in phrases like 'last month', 'last week', 'weeks ago', 'yesterday' or 'this past February'.
modes.example: (Second in a series) Last<< month>> we provided perspectives on the food and fuel

modes.label: Earlier-issue references
modes.description: A verb or word that points back to something already published or happened earlier.
modes.example: Editor's note: Part I of Dr. Chen's column<< appeared>> in the May issue of Acupuncture Today

card.writes: It pushes against future-oriented words like 'upcoming', 'future' and 'tomorrow', and favors words about time since something happened.
card.plain: It marks words that say something happened in the past, like 'last month' or 'weeks ago'.
